findings.title: Materiality threshold in code differs from documented definition of default
findings.observation: RDS documentation §3.3 states EUR 100 / 1%. The RDS build script applies EUR 250 absolute (rds_build.py L214).
findings.impact: Default flag understated for small arrears → PD calibration potentially too low.
findings.challenge: Since when has EUR 250 been applied, and to which vintages of the RDS?
evidenceQuotes: EVD-01-RDS v1.0 §3.3: “more than 90 days past due above a materiality threshold of EUR 100 absolute and 1% relative”

findings.title: MoC category A underestimates data deficiency impact
findings.observation: MDD §7.2 applies +6% for the approximated default flag 2012–2015; validation sensitivity indicates ~+11%.
findings.impact: Capital requirement understated until MoC recalibrated.
findings.challenge: Please provide the sensitivity analysis supporting +6%.
evidenceQuotes: EVD-01-MDD v4.0 §7.2: “A MoC of +6% relative is applied to the long-run average default rate”
EVD-01-RDS v1.0 §6.2: “The default flag for 2012–2015 was approximated”
